$description: Component contracts for the FM Bomboniere site, derived from src/components. Visual specs: design/DESIGN.md; tokens: design/fm.tokens.json. All copy comes from src/i18n.tsx (IT/EN); all photos from src/data/gallery.json via src/data.ts.

components.name: Header
alsoExports: NAV (section ids + i18n keys, shared with Footer)
components.behaviour: Fixed bar, 64px / 72px from 1024px. Transparent over the hero; after 24px scroll gets .glass (white 82% + blur 12px, solid white fallback) and a line border. Logo link scrolls to #top. Desktop nav + LangToggle; below 1024px a hamburger opens a full-screen ivory overlay (clip-path circle 0.6s expo.inOut, links stagger 0.06).
components.a11y: Nav landmarks labelled 'nav.label'. Toggle has aria-expanded, aria-controls='mobile-menu' and a localized aria-label. Overlay is inert while closed. Open: focus moves to the first link, Tab/Shift+Tab trapped across toggle + overlay controls, Esc closes and returns focus to the toggle; scroll locked. LangToggle is role=group with aria-pressed buttons carrying lang attributes, 44px targets.

components.name: Intro

props.onDone: () => void, called when the curtain finishes or is skipped

components.behaviour: Ivory curtain with the logo: fade/scale 0.94->1 (0.6s), then lifts yPercent -100 (0.7s expo.inOut). Once per session (sessionStorage 'fm-intro').
components.a11y: aria-hidden. Skipped entirely under prefers-reduced-motion; onDone fires immediately.

components.name: Hero

props.ready: boolean; entrance animation waits until the intro is done

components.behaviour: Sky-to-white wash. Eyebrow, split h1 (two lines, one italic accent), lead, primary CTA to #galleria and outline CTA to #contatti. Collage: arch photo with Sparkles + two stacked photos (heroPhotos), eager-loaded. Below 1024px, arch vertically centered beside the stack with no bottom padding; desktop retains bottom alignment and stack padding. Line/clip-path reveals; parallax yPercent +-6 scrub on desktop only.
components.a11y: section#top labelled by h1#hero-title. CTAs are real anchors (work without JS). All motion inside matchMedia(no-preference).

components.name: About
components.behaviour: Section #chi-siamo, white-to-blush wash. Arch portrait (aboutPhoto) with logo medallion, split h2, two paragraphs, Ornament, list of occasions. Below 768px, two aligned columns without separators; wider layouts wrap with rose-gold hairlines. sectionReveals.
components.a11y: Labelled by h2#about-title; occasions are a real list; decorative medallion and separators have empty alt / aria-hidden.

components.name: Collections

props.onPick: (c: Collection) => void; App sets the gallery filter and scrolls to #galleria

components.behaviour: Section #collezioni on sky. One card per collection present in the manifest: 4:5 cover photo, serif name, photo count, arrow.
components.a11y: Each card is a <button> with aria-label 'col.view' (e.g. 'Vedi nella galleria: Matrimonio'); cover image alt is empty (decorative, name is in the label).

components.name: Gallery
components.behaviour: Section #galleria. Filter chips (Tutte + present collections) animate the grid with GSAP Flip (0.6s power3.inOut; entering fade/scale .96->1, leaving fade .2s). Grid 2/3/4 columns, dense flow, landscape photos span 2 columns from 768px. Lazy srcset images (640w thumb + full).
components.a11y: Chips: role=group labelled 'gal.filters', aria-pressed, aria-controls='gallery-grid', 44px tall. Each tile is a <button> with aria-label 'gal.open' + alt text, opening Lightbox. No Flip under reduced motion.

components.name: Lightbox
components.behaviour: Native modal <dialog>. Opens with backdrop fade .3s and image growing from the tile rect (0.55s); prev/next crossfade .35s + x 24px; close .4s. Counter 'n / total', caption = alt + collection. Swipe >50px changes photo. Scroll locked while open.
components.a11y: showModal() makes the page inert and traps focus; aria-label 'lb.label'; close button autofocused. Esc (cancel event) closes, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight navigate, focus returns to the originating tile. Caption is aria-live=polite with a screen-reader counter. Controls 44px. Reduced motion: 150ms opacity only.

components.name: Contact
components.behaviour: Section #contatti, blush wash. Address (Google Maps link), phone (tel:), WhatsApp, email (mailto:), Instagram, Facebook as large rows with line icons (internal Row component). Google Maps iframe mounts only when its box is within 300px of the viewport.
components.a11y: Rows inside <address> as a list; external links open in a new tab with rel=noopener noreferrer; >= 64px rows. Iframe has a localized title.

components.name: Footer
components.behaviour: Dark logo-disc band: large logo, owner line, tagline, NAV links, address/phone/email, Instagram/Facebook icon buttons, ornament divider, (c) current year, back-to-top.
components.a11y: Nav labelled 'nav.label'; icon links have aria-label; all targets >= 44px; text white/80+ on #2b2729.

components.name: SplitHeading
components.behaviour: Wraps each line in .line-mask spans (data-split) for the yPercent 110->0 reveal; no split library.
components.a11y: Renders a real heading; text stays in DOM order and visible without JS.

components.name: Img
components.behaviour: Responsive with 640w thumb + full srcset, explicit width/height, lazy unless eager (eager also sets fetchPriority=high), async decoding.
components.a11y: Caller supplies localized alt (empty when decorative).

components.name: Ornament
components.behaviour: Rose-gold hairline + Star section divider; at most one per section.

components.name: Sparkles
components.behaviour: Six rose-gold stars twinkling (CSS keyframes, 3.4-5.6s offset cycles) around the hero arch; paused while offscreen via IntersectionObserver.
components.a11y: aria-hidden, pointer-events none; display:none under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Icon
components.behaviour: Line icon set, 24px viewBox, 1.5px stroke, currentColor.
components.a11y: aria-hidden; the parent control carries the accessible name.

app.behaviour: Skip link to #main (visible on focus), Intro, Header, main (Hero, About, Collections, Gallery, Contact), Footer. Owns the gallery filter state; starts Lenis (skipped under reduced motion) and honours an initial #hash.
